# Final Launch Report — Example Grant Project

Report length: 28 pages (this is the text edition of the delivered PDF)
Reporting period: full rollout, 2026-09-01 to 2026-10-16
Prepared by: Builder team

## 1. Rollout timeline

- Week 1: infrastructure and staging environment.
- Weeks 2–3: marketing website build and content.
- Week 4: documentation and public repository.
- Week 5: closed beta with 40 invited users.
- Week 6: production launch.

## 2. What shipped

- Marketing website live in production (homepage, about, contact form).
- Public documentation repository (README, API reference, changelog).
- Product application deployed and reachable from the live site.

## 3. Metrics at launch

- 40 beta users onboarded; 37 completed the full flow.
- Signup-to-activated conversion: 62% during beta week.
- Median page load: 1.1 s on production hosting.
- Zero severity-1 incidents during the launch window.

## 4. The product working end to end

A full walkthrough was recorded and verified: a new user signs up from
the homepage, confirms their account, completes onboarding, creates a
first project inside the product, invites a teammate, and exports a
report — the complete flow from signup to a finished task works in
production with no manual intervention.

## 5. Conclusion

The rollout is complete: every deliverable in the grant is live, and the
product is shown working end to end above.
